mobbin:9b7b370a-b591-4494-b083-228f11e6f.summary: From the library, the user picks how to create a demo, fills in a step, sets preview options, then reviews engagement and where viewers drop off at each step.
steps: How would you like to get started?
Empty editor: Add from / Capture with
Step work area with design and details
Preview: layout, logo, main button, feature switches
Insights: sample metrics and step funnel
steal: The start screen groups the recording options ('Chrome Extension', 'Desktop App') under a Popular label, next to uploading or turning a video into a demo (screen 2).
An empty step offers two sets of sources: add from your computer, the library or another demo, or capture with the extension, desktop app or Figma (screen 3).
Edit, Preview and Insights tabs keep editing, the learner's view and completion data in one project (screens 4-8).
A chart shows how many viewers carry on or drop off at each step ('From Step N: conversion / drop-off %') (screen 8).
avoid: Sample data and an Upgrade banner at the end of editing are a warning: completion data for the pre-brief should not sit behind a paywall (screens 6-8).
mobbin:9b7b370a-b591-4494-b083-228f11e6f.fit: Scenario manager: grow today's Briefing tab video into the planned interactive orientation and pre-brief maker, with an outline and clickable spots. The preview switches map to what learners see before a session. Do not copy Arcade's sales-demo insights and buttons wholesale.

mobbin:644ef98c-516f-47e4-97e5-ee9ce4635.summary: On a demo step, the user edits the text of a clickable callout, generates a voiceover from that text, then reviews the voiceover timeline with 'Edit voiceover'.
steps: Clickable spot settings: text and 'Generate voiceover'
Voiceover timeline under the work area
steal: The written callout text is the only source for 'Generate voiceover', so one script drives both the caption and the audio (screen 1).
Clickable spots come in three styles (Hotspot, Area, Callout) and can be set to 'Open by default' (screen 1).
Each clickable spot can jump to another step, chosen from a list (screen 1).
After generating, a voiceover timeline at the bottom shows the sound wave, the length and 'Edit voiceover' (screen 2).
mobbin:644ef98c-516f-47e4-97e5-ee9ce4635.fit: Scenario manager: supports the new interactive orientation maker with narration per step. It is also a pattern for scripts (a written cue, then optional audio) without a Maestro-style stage editor.
